mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) over a 3-month period signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input shortages and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises > 5 points during the signal period, indicating labor market weakness is transient.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling mortgage rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing affordability index (NAR) falls below 100 during the signal period, indicating that rising prices are offsetting the positive impact of lower rates.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation expectations that will drive the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 5y5y forward inflation expectations (from TIPS breakevens) remain below 2% during the signal period, indicating that the CPI spike is seen as transitory.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100k jobs in a month
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims (ICSA) fall below 200k during the signal period, indicating that the payroll drop is an outlier rather than a trend.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising retail sales (RSAFS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 5% YoY AND UNRATE falls > 0.5pp in 6 months
failure_condition: Consumer sentiment (UMich) falls > 10 points during the signal period, indicating that the sales strength is unlikely to persist.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a surge in economic activity that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM manufacturing PMI falls below 50 during the signal period, indicating that the production surge is not broadly based.
